description: A sprite sheet of EIGHT separate farm yard props arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a square patch of freshly tilled brown soil with furrows seen from slightly above, the same square patch of tilled soil darker and wet after watering, a short straight wooden picket fence segment, a small wooden fence gate. Bottom row: a wooden shipping crate with a hinged lid and a metal latch, a friendly scarecrow with a stitched burlap sack head and patched shirt on a pole, a wooden water barrel with a metal band and a ladle, a small wooden rack holding a hoe, a rake and a watering can. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural muted colors, every prop fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
